required_multiswap_checks: Verify whether the current MultiSWAP runtime has a real production composition seam capable of invoking the exact admitted SNOW process without modifying its equations or time semantics.
Snow-inactive columns allocate no persistent snow state and incur no persistent snow workspace allocation.
Snow-active columns own only the admitted persistent ssnow/slw-equivalent state; immutable snow parameters are referenced/shared rather than copied as mutable continuation state.
Per-column one-call-daily SNOW results are bitwise identical to direct F-VQ16 process calls for identical committed state and forcing.
Mixed active/inactive column batches preserve inactive identity and cross-column state isolation.
Checkpoint, rejected trial, rollback, replay and accepted commit preserve exact snow state independently per column.
A rejected or retried trial never publishes snow state or consumes the daily SNOW event twice.
Authoritative F-KT mass accounting includes snow storage change, snowfall/rain inputs and sublimation exactly once when SNOW is active.
Melt is transferred exactly once from snow to the receiving surface/soil component and is not double counted as an external whole-system loss.
Retained liquid water is not double counted on top of total snow water storage.
Mass completeness remains fail-closed if any required receiving-component contribution is unavailable.
One-call-daily event semantics are preserved for non-midnight intervals; subdaily and arbitrary-duration SNOW remain fail-closed.
Order reversal, A/B/A replay and multi-column counts demonstrate deterministic per-column identity.
No new scientific tolerance and no silent change of execution policy, Richards physics, HeadCalc, solver policy, coupling or fallback semantics.
